deadline.value: Fall international PhD applications are due March 1; the page prints no year, so 2027 is inferred for Fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: Thesis and PhD Domestic June 1 November 1 International March 1 October 1

gre_general.value: The CS department waives the GRE for graduate applicants.
gre_general.quote: GRE is waived for CS Grad applicants.

gre_subject.value: The CS PhD does not require the GRE; the field has no subject test.

supervisor.value: The page says students work with a faculty advisor during the PhD, not whether one must agree before admission.

funding.value: Teaching and research assistantships are generally awarded to PhD applicants, according to the university FAQ; the department gives no separate figure.
funding.quote: Both Assistantships are generally awarded to Masters Thesis (MS-T) and Doctoral (PHD) level applicants.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is the requirement, and a master's is helpful but not required.
entry_route.quote: A master’s degree is helpful but not required.

notes: Fall priority deadline is encouraged for funding (CS application page). Spring 2027 deadlines on the program page are for Spring entry.
